body.x: WAYBAY participated in ‘CES 2018(Consumer Technology Show)’, the world’s largest IT consumer electronics show held in Las Vegas, the U.S.A. from Tues. 9th to Fri. 12th in Jan. and introduced AR technology for future cars.

WAYBAY designs and manufactures automotive AR application. WAYBAY as a leader in the automotive AR hardware market, is leading a new area for integrated solutions. Through hardware and software complemented by ‘True AR SDK’, developer can create environments for creating automotive augmented reality application program. Augmented reality allows a driver to experience the virtual world around a car that moves and changes according to the path and the driver’s preferences, which is not limited to just small screens. It has a merit that it is fully integrated into the real world and the driver can see at various depths.

CES, the world’s largest IT exhibition, is an exhibition of trends in the global consumer electronics industry, held annually in January by the American Consumer Technology Association (CTA). Aving News reported the most issues of CES, MWC, and IFA, which are world's top three tech exhibitions, during last 11 years. It is sending special reporters to CES for this year as well; reporting major issues in the world market and introduce Korea's major companies all over the world.
